meta.trip: Henann Garden Resort, Station 2, Boracay, 7 people, 2026-11-24 to 2026-11-28
meta.method: WebSearch only. WebFetch was blocked for every non-allowlisted host (wanderlog.com, primer.com.ph, nominatim.openstreetmap.org failed DNS), and Bash curl to overpass-api.de, nominatim and openstreetmap.org was refused by the egress proxy. So no page was opened directly: every fact below comes from search-result snippets, and the quoted source URL is the page the snippet came from.
meta.coordinates_policy: No coordinates could be verified (OSM and Google Maps unreachable). Every lat/lon is null. Do not fill them from memory; geocode on a machine with OSM access before publishing.
meta.ratings_policy: Google Maps ratings were never seen, so google_rating is null everywhere. TripAdvisor and Trip.com figures seen in snippets go in other_ratings.

places.name: HaloMango (D'Mall)

still_operating.evidence: TripAdvisor page labelled '2025 Reviews' (tripadvisor.ca) and Trip.com listings 'HaloMango - D'Mall'. No 2026 confirmation seen.

places.address_landmark: Inside D'Mall, Station 2, Balabag (Trip.com: 'Boat Station 2'). Only the D'Mall branch was found; no other Boracay branch was confirmed.
places.hours: Opens 09:00 (Trip.com snapshot). Closing time not verified.

signature_items.ko: 망고 소프트아이스크림 컵. 작은 사이즈도 양이 넉넉함
signature_items.source: TripAdvisor reviews (snippets; 150 in older reviews, 190 to-go in a later one)

signature_items.ko: 망고 소프트아이스크림 라지. 달다는 평이 많음
망고 빙수(할로할로 변형). 큰 사이즈는 2인 공유
패밀리 사이즈 과일 빙수. 리뷰상 약 9명 공유 가능 (7인 가족에 적합)

places.vat_service_charge: Reviewers report an extra 10% service charge when eating in. Take-away avoids it.
places.price_note: Pricey for a dessert by local standards but generous portions. Reviewers disagree on value.
places.group_of_7_notes: Small shop with frequent queues and about a 10-minute wait after ordering (reviews). One of the few air-conditioned shops. Order 1-2 family-size bowls to share and expect limited seating.

places.name: Lemoni Café & Restaurant

still_operating.evidence: Listed on Philippine Primer (Jan 2024) and current hotels.com / Klook pages. No 2026-dated proof.

places.hours: Daily 07:00-23:00 (most listings). An older 2019 guide said 07:00-22:00, last order 21:30.

signature_items.ko: 시그니처 레몬 머랭·레몬 타르트. 새콤해서 커피와 잘 어울림 (평 엇갈림)
샥슈카(토마토 달걀 요리). 브런치 인기 메뉴
케이크·페이스트리. '70페소부터'는 오래된 가이드 수치
signature_items.source: Old guide snippet: 'Php 70 for pastries, Php 400 for main course'

signature_items.ko: 식사 메뉴(파스타·샌드위치 등) 대략 가격
망고 디저트. 마켓매닐라 리뷰에서 호평

places.price_note: Reviewers call it 'not budget friendly', but say the cakes are worth it.
places.group_of_7_notes: Good for breakfast or brunch with the whole family. Seating capacity is unverified, so arrive early.

places.name: Real Coffee & Tea Café (Home of the Original Calamansi Muffin)

still_operating.evidence: Yelp page titled 'Updated November 2026' gives '2F Sea World, Station 2'. Philippine Primer article dated 2025-09-17.

places.address_landmark: MOVED: now at 2/F Sea World building, Station 2, Balabag (Yelp, Booky, Silverbackpacker). One guide calls it a 'new and bigger beachfront location in Station 2'. The original 1996 spot was down a beachfront passageway. Some listings now use the name 'Real Coffee and Tea'.

signature_items.ko: 깔라만시 머핀 6개 박스. 1996년부터 이어진 원조 시그니처, 선물용으로 인기
아이스 카페 모카
이전 가격 참고용

places.price_note: Fair. Muffins work out to about PHP 60 each.
places.group_of_7_notes: It is on a second floor, so check stair access for older family members. Buy muffin boxes to take away for the group.

places.name: Coco Mama

still_operating.evidence: Manila Bulletin, 2026-02-04: '10 years later, Coco Mama still tastes like Boracay' (10th anniversary on 2026-01-30).

places.address_landmark: Branch locations conflict. A blog says 'D'Mall Palengke (at the back)'. Korean blogs say inside D'Mall. A HappyCow listing names a 'Station 1' branch. Trip.com lists 216 Main Rd. Confirm on site.

signature_items.item: Coco Mama coconut ice cream in a coconut shell (with coconut meat, sticky rice, pinipig)
signature_items.ko: 코코넛 껍질에 담아주는 비건 코코넛 아이스크림. 코코넛 과육·찹쌀·피니픽 토핑
signature_items.source: Inquirer Plus snippet (Coco/Ube/Mango Mama variants at P320)

signature_items.ko: 우베(보라 고구마) 버전
망고 버전 (2023년 출시)
signature_items.source: Inquirer Plus snippet; MB 2023-10-14 launch article

places.price_history_note: Older prices: P95 (old blog), P150 (review), 'starts at PhP180' (2022 magazine). Use P320 as the likely current price, but treat it as unconfirmed.
places.price_note: Pricey for ice cream but iconic. Splitting one between two people is common.
places.group_of_7_notes: Kiosk-style with little seating. Order 4 to share among 7.
places.official_url: Facebook: cocomamaboracay (handle seen in a snippet; URL not opened)

places.name: Starbucks Boracay (Station 2 beachfront)

still_operating.evidence: Only undated reviews (Wanderlog, Remyeats). No official store-locator page seen.

places.address_landmark: Front beach, Station 2 (reviews). Three floors with an outdoor 3rd floor and a sea view from the 2nd floor. Not confirmed whether it is inside D'Mall.
places.hours: Opens about 06:30 (one review). Closing time unverified.
places.signature_items_note: Standard Philippine Starbucks menu. No Boracay-specific prices were verified.
places.vat_service_charge: Restroom and Wi-Fi codes are printed on the receipt (review).
places.price_note: Same prices as Starbucks elsewhere in the Philippines (reviewer).
places.group_of_7_notes: Multiple floors make seating a group of 7 easier than at the small dessert shops.

places.name: 7-Eleven (Station 2 / D'Mall area)
places.open24h_confidence: medium: a 2018 Yoorekka guide says 'all branches are open 24 hours daily' and one hotel review mentions a '24-hour 7-Eleven' two minutes from D'Mall

still_operating.evidence: Hotel reviews (Agoda, Trip.com) and a 2026 travel guide mention a 7-Eleven near D'Mall. No official branch list seen.

places.address_landmark: Several branches across the Station 1-2 main-road area. One review places one 'beside the police station' in Station 2. No exact address was verified.
places.group_of_7_notes: Snacks, water and toiletries. Best for late-night top-ups.

places.name: Budget Mart (D'Mall)

still_operating.evidence: myboracayguide shopping page (entry updated 2026-07-29 per snippet). Operating at D'Mall since 2005.

places.address_landmark: D'Mall, Station 2 (D'Mall Market side), Main Road. A second branch is at E-Mall, Station 3.
places.hours: 07:00-23:30 per one entry, 08:00-23:00 per another in the same guide (they conflict)
places.group_of_7_notes: The best place nearby for bulk water, fruit, snacks and souvenirs such as dried mango.
places.official_url: https://budgetmart.com.ph (named in a snippet; not opened)

places.name: Bysshe Pharmacy (D'Mall)
places.notes: A guide says D'Mall has '2 small pharmacies which sell basic supplies'. Other D'Mall pharmacies named in directories are G&C Medicine Center and Farmacia Alenjen (hours unverified). Farmacia Gomez is at Tirol Shopping Center.

places.name: Watsons Boracay Beach Front

still_operating.evidence: Official Watsons store page wtcph_6811 (seen in a search snippet).

places.address_landmark: Beach Front, Station 1, Brgy. Balabag (official page). A guide also mentions a Watsons inside D'Mall plus one across from Lake Town, but the official site lists only the Beach Front and CityMall stores in the results seen.

places.name: Watsons CityMall Boracay
places.address_landmark: GF CityMall Boracay, main road just north of Station 1 near the Diniwid turn-off. This is probably beyond 1.2 km from Henann Garden. The guide calls it the biggest pharmacy on the island. Savemore supermarket is in the same mall.

places.name: Ciriaco S. Tirol Hospital (government hospital)

still_operating.evidence: Recent news coverage (Ground News item on emergency referral delays) and myboracayguide. GMA describes it as an infirmary-level facility for simple emergencies only.

places.phone: (036) 288-3041, +63 946 209 2384 (myboracayguide). ER hotline 152 is on the MyBoracayGuide map (Issue 29).
places.notes: Serious cases are transferred to Kalibo (Dr. Rafael S. Tumbokon Memorial Hospital). Other emergency numbers seen: 911 (national), 106 and 288-2068 (Boracay hotline per myboracayguide). Which of these are current is unverified.

places.name: Metropolitan Doctors Medical Clinic & Laboratory

still_operating.evidence: Active job posting for a 'Doctor on Duty' (doctorjobs.today) and myboracayguide listing.

places.address_landmark: Boracay Highway Central, Station 3 (2020 listing). myboracayguide says it has clinics in both Station 2 and Station 3.

places.name: Saint Gabriel Medical Center
places.address_landmark: Ambulong Road, Brgy. Manoc-Manoc (Station 3 side). Farther than 1.2 km from Henann Garden.

places.name: Epic Boracay

still_operating.evidence: Philippine Primer article dated 2025-09-17. A 2026 TripAdvisor review was referenced in a snippet.

places.hours: 07:00-04:00 (Primer) or 09:00-04:00 (hotels.com). Happy hour starts at 12:00 noon, 'the longest on the island', with up to 50% off drinks.

signature_items.item: The Epic Burger (US Angus patty, bacon, cheddar, fried egg)
signature_items.ko: 에픽 버거. 미국산 앵거스 패티·베이컨·체다·계란 프라이, 베스트셀러
해산물 마리나라 파스타
깔라만시 뮬 칵테일
밤 클럽 타임 입장료(음료 1잔 포함)

places.typical_spend_pp_php: 700-1,200 for a meal and a drink (estimate from the 2025 prices; unverified)
places.price_note: On the pricier side (2026 TripAdvisor review), though some reviewers call it reasonable for the location.
places.group_of_7_notes: Daytime and early evening are fine for a family meal on the beach. After about 22:00 it turns into a club and is adults only in practice.
places.official_url: https://epicboracay.com (named in a snippet; not opened)

places.name: Exit Bar

still_operating.evidence: Listed in Arrival Guides and Trip.com (undated). No 2025-2026 proof.

signature_items.ko: 병맥주. 오래된 리뷰 기준 가격이라 지금은 더 비쌀 가능성 큼

places.price_note: An old review describes it as cheap; Arrival Guides lists it as 'higher end'. The sources conflict.
places.group_of_7_notes: Small, rustic, hippie-style bar for adults. Not suited to children.
